name: Reliance
description: The Reliance was a Galactic Republic warship that served as the flagship for Admiral Jimas Veltraa during the Mandalorian Wars. During a Mandalorian advance that threatened the planet Taris in 3964 BBY, Veltraa reformed what remained of the shattered Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line into a makeshift force to defend Taris from a Mandalorian siege. Although Veltraa and the Reliance held out to the very end, the ship was eventually destroyed with all hands lost.
